evidence.title: AIエージェントの評価と品質保証 — 「動く」を「信頼できる」に変える検収の技術

name: AIエージェントの評価と品質保証
summary: Free Zenn book on verifying AI-written code: eval specs, task datasets, LLM graders, repeated runs and acceptance records.
description: Japanese-language Zenn book (13 chapters, ~88,000 characters, updated October 2026, free to read) about turning AI-written implementations into work you can reliably accept. It covers evaluation specs, growing an eval dataset, code-based and LLM-based grading, validating graders themselves, repeated runs, continuous evaluation after model or prompt changes, and keeping acceptance records, tied together by a shared TypeScript app; appendices add templates and the sources and run records behind the experiments.
contains: experiments: a six-known-failure grader test, one task implemented six times, LLM judging of four reports
templates for evaluation and acceptance in the appendix
built around a shared TypeScript example app
